AppConfig.description: A managed application: a launch specification, not a window.

oneOf.description: Audio routing. Absent leaves routing untouched; `{"output": null}` silences.

env.description:
Extra environment variables for the launched process.

Applied last, so they override anything the launcher preset sets.
Hardware acceleration usually needs this: enabling NVDEC on an Nvidia
card, for instance, is a matter of `LIBVA_DRIVER_NAME` and
`NVD_BACKEND` rather than any command-line flag.

oneOf.description: Output the window is moved to. When absent, Sway's default placement applies.

persistProfile.description: Keep the browser profile between launches instead of wiping it.

oneOf.description: Wait for this URL to answer before launching.

spanOutputs.description:
Stretch one window across *every* output instead of filling one.

This is sway's `fullscreen enable global`, and it is how a single
browser drives a video wall: the outputs are positioned to form one
canvas, and the window covers the whole of it. When set, `output`
only decides where the window first appears.

AppState.description:
Lifecycle state of a supervised application.

Values are camelCase like the rest of the API: `lowercase` would render
`WaitingForOutput` as the unreadable `waitingforoutput`.

AppStatus.description: Runtime status of a supervised application.

detail.description: Human-readable detail for the current state.

lastHeartbeat.description: Unix seconds of the most recent heartbeat, when the watchdog is enabled.

startedAt.description: Unix seconds when the current process was spawned.

windowIds.description: Sway container ids currently attributed to this app.

AudioConfig.description: Where an application's audio should go.

output.description: PipeWire `node.name` of the target sink. `null` routes to silence.

AudioSink.description: An audio sink reported by PipeWire.

id.description: PipeWire `node.name` — stable across reboots and replugging.

isDefault.description: True when this is PipeWire's current default sink.

isNullSink.description: True for the null sink Suede manages for silent routing.

outputHint.description: Video connector this sink is associated with, where derivable.

Background.description:
What an output shows behind, or instead of, any window.

An appliance with a blank screen looks broken even when it is merely
between launches, so a background gives it something deliberate to show
while a browser restarts or before the first app starts.

color.description: `#rrggbb`, shown where the wallpaper does not reach, or on its own.

wallpaper.description: Id of an uploaded wallpaper. Absent means use `color` alone.

BackgroundMode.description: How a wallpaper is scaled onto an output, matching `sway-output(5)`.

Check.description: An environment health check, as served by `GET /system/checks`.

docsUrl.description: Link to the documentation page describing manual resolution.

fixDescription.description: What the fix would do, shown before it is invoked.

CheckStatus.description: Result of a single environment health check.

section.description: Which part of the document changed: `all`, `outputs`, `apps`, `settings`.

revision.description: Monotonic revision, incremented by Suede on every accepted write.

schemaVersion.description: Document schema version, managed by Suede.

Divergence.description: Something desired that could not be realized.

docsUrl.description:
Where to read about this kind of problem.

Carried here, rather than left for each client to work out, so that
anything consuming the API can offer the same help the bundled UI does.

subject.description: Resource the divergence concerns, e.g. an output name or app id.

startupGraceSeconds.description: Time allowed after launch for the first heartbeat to arrive.

timeoutSeconds.description: Silence tolerated once armed, before the app is killed and relaunched.

oneOf.description: Chromium with Suede's kiosk argument set.

uri.description: URI to load. Supports `{appId}` and `{heartbeatUrl}` placeholders.

oneOf.description: Firefox with its kiosk argument set.

Mode.description: A display mode. Refresh is in Hz (Sway reports mHz on the wire).

Output.description: A video output as reported by Sway's `get_outputs`.

active.description: Whether Sway currently has this output enabled.

modes.description: All modes the display advertises, deduplicated.

rect.description: Position and size in the global layout.

serial.description: EDID serial, where the display provides one.

allowTearing.description: Applied only when the detected Sway version supports it (≥ 1.10).

oneOf.description: What this output shows when no window covers it.

enable.description: Whether the output should be enabled. `false` actively disables it.

match.description: Which physical output this entry applies to.

maxRenderTimeMs.description: Maximum milliseconds allowed to render a frame; `null` means off.

oneOf.description: Mode to apply. When absent, Sway's preferred mode is left in place.
Position in the global layout. Suede performs no layout arithmetic.

OutputMatch.description: Rule selecting which physical output a config entry applies to.

name.description: Connector name, e.g. `HDMI-A-1`. The default and most direct way to match.

PackageVersion.description: Version of a package relevant to Suede's operation.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

type.description: URI reference identifying the error type.

ReadinessConfig.description:
Wait for a URL to answer before launching an application.

A kiosk browser started before the service it points at is serving shows an
error page and stays there, since nothing reloads it. Gating the launch on
the service answering removes that race entirely.

expectStatus.description: Status codes that mean ready. Empty means any 2xx.

giveUpAfterSeconds.description:
Give up waiting after this long and launch anyway. `null` waits forever,
which is usually right for an appliance: showing an error page is worse
than showing the background until the service appears.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long a single attempt may take.

url.description: URL to poll. Only `http://` is supported.

RestartPolicyKind.description: Restart behaviour after an application exits.

RestartReason.description: Why an app was last restarted.

Settings.description: Daemon-level settings that belong to desired state.

hideCursor.description: Hide the pointer and park it beyond the layout.

outputPollIntervalSeconds.description: Backstop poll interval for output changes.

lastReconciled.description: Unix seconds of the last completed reconciliation pass.

revision.description: Desired-state revision the last pass applied.

SwayCommand.description: A raw Sway command, for debugging.

SystemInfo.description: Daemon and environment information, as served by `GET /system`.

supportsTearing.description: Feature gates resolved from the detected Sway version.

webUiEnabled.description: True when the reference web UI is being served.

Transform.description: Screen rotation and flipping, as accepted by `sway-output(5)`.

Wallpaper.description: Metadata for a stored wallpaper, as served by the API.

id.description: Client-chosen identifier, referenced from an output's background.

uploadedAt.description: Unix seconds when it was stored.

app.description: Id of the Suede-managed app that owns this window, where known.

output.description: Name of the output this window is displayed on, where known.

bearer.description: Optional. When a token is configured, every endpoint except /healthz and the heartbeat endpoint requires it.
